rules: Lifecycle reuses the BD/REX register: TODO -> ACTIVE -> DONE -> CONTROL; SUPERSEDED, INVALIDATED and UNKNOWN_NEEDS_READER are terminal or reader states.
DONE requires a merged repair plus current-code survival evidence. CONTROL additionally requires prevention or detection plus a later distinct-source repeat.
A state change is recorded as a history row keyed by series ordinal (wave.cycle.iteration.sub), never by wall-clock time. The item's current state is its last history row.

Flow is orthogonal to lifecycle: READY can start now, IN_PR is under review, BLOCKED waits on another item, HOLD waits on a re-entry predicate, RETURN_OWNER waits on an owner or admin action, LINKED is driven by another issue.
A queue item may be closed only by evidence. Forecasts never close items.
